prompt:
A young man of twenty-five stands on a Berlin pavement on a bright weekday
morning, seen from the waist up, three quarters turned to his right, left of
centre in a vertical frame. He wears a light blue shirt with the sleeves
rolled up and dark navy trousers. Behind him the pavement runs on with a
broad red-painted bicycle strip beside a grey pedestrian strip, bicycles
parked against a plain pale building front, and a pedestrian traffic light
further along the street. Daylight, overcast and even. He looks at a point
beyond the right edge of the frame and does not face the camera.
